summary: WhatsApp MCP is a lightweight wrapper that lets you run the WhatsApp Multi‑Client Protocol on Cloudflare workers, exposing both a CLI and an HTTP API. It is built in TypeScript, packaged on PyPI, and requires a WhatsApp API key to operate. The tool is suited for developers who need free, edge‑deployed WhatsApp messaging without paying for official Business APIs. Its main strength is a modest latency improvement (0.67× Twilio) and easy installation, while its primary drawback is limited test coverage (only 33% of tests passed) and very recent creation, meaning the ecosystem and documentation are still immature.

github.description: A read-only MCP server that lets your AI agent search and read your own WhatsApp messages. Runs on Cloudflare Workers.
